title: Extend conditional P112 mixed-rank shortening to common cut33
body:
## Summary

```diff
- Conditional P112 common-cut bound: 32, residual support ranks 5/6/6
+ Conditional P112 common-cut bound: 33, residual support ranks 5/6/6
```

Prove that three arbitrary residual pieces of binary support ranks at most 5, 6, 6 outside ONE arbitrary common cut of at most 33 coordinates meet the restricted root code in dimension at most one, over every characteristic-zero field. The new full D6 axis lemma bounds the union of a rank-five and rank-six support by 28. The proof covers D6 union sizes 82, 84 and the newly permitted 85.

The result is conditional on the explicitly retained P112 capacities, small-fiber capacity, A2 incidence, PR3295 concentration, PR3292 four-puncture capacity and Weyl normalization premises. No sharpness, new caller exclusion, full C5, supplier, selected-frontier change or kappa is claimed. Credit PR3299/3295/3292 and their E8/P112/root-simplex lineage, David Arias, joaqcoo, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and the related PR3286 witness. Exact predecessor proof bytes, pins, limits and Open next questions are committed.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19005415

## Evidence

- Before: PR3299 explicitly left cut33 open. After: the conditional proof has coverage upper bound 48 against required 49, 51 and 52 in the D6 cases, and E6 incidence 86 against required 90.
- Complete primary replay checks 97,155 five-spaces, 10,795 six-spaces, 311,328 critical unions and all 7,560 ordered-axis transports. A separate root-basis method checks 237,336 subsets and corroborates the critical bound. Its outside-bulk limits are explicit.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay, optimized source/type/behavior controls, Ruff, exact committed-byte comparisons, official archive integrity and all three actual optimized read-only Git-free CPython 3.13 scripts pass.
- The designated internal peer receipt is retained in REVIEW.json. Its one documentation finding was corrected by explicitly naming the already pinned small-fiber capacity8 premise. Code, source and witness bytes stayed unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py   --package research/p112-mixed566-cut33
```

Inherited historical proof/census suites, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, human and proof-kernel review remain unrun. Internal computational review does not admit a supplier.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One new opt-in research package. Frozen predecessors and selected records remain unchanged. Source authentication is separate from mathematical admission.
